layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for ticket CSV export

graderOnly: The implementation in app/exports/csv_export.py meets AC-001 and AC-002: it writes the header id,title,status,created_at and then one row per ticket using csv.writer with the default excel dialect, so values with commas, double quotes, and line breaks are quoted and round-trip unchanged through csv.reader.
app/exports/csv_export.py imports only the csv module; nothing under app/exports/ calls app/llm/client.py or app/summaries/.
No test of the export exists before the run; tests/test_summaries.py holds three passing tests of the summaries only.

all.why: the report exists at the fixed path with this cycle's VERIFICATION provenance
Claude Code invocation for the next role

roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: The existing tests (summaries only) pass with python3 -m pytest.

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c "import csv,io;from datetime import datetime;from app.tickets.models import Ticket;from app.exports.csv_export import export_tickets;v='a, '+chr(34)+'b'+chr(34)+chr(10)+'c';s=io.StringIO();export_tickets([Ticket(1,v,'open',datetime(2026,9,1,8,0)),Ticket(2,'plain','closed',datetime(2026,9,2,9,30))],s);rows=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(s.getvalue())));assert rows==[['id','title','status','created_at'],['1',v,'open','2026-09-01T08:00:00'],['2','plain','closed','2026-09-02T09:30:00']],rows;print('export ok')"
selfChecks.why: The export meets AC-001 and AC-002 (grader-only fact): header, one row per ticket, and quoted values round-trip.
Package registries are blocked, so nothing can be installed.
The LLM provider host is unreachable during the run.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Pre-install 00-tickets (Ticket dataclass, pyproject with pytest testpaths, README) and 01-summaries (app/llm/client.py urllib client for an OpenAI-compatible API, app/summaries/service.py, tests/test_summaries.py with a fake client, 3 tests) form the existing project history. 50-design commits CONTEXT.md, MODE.md, the scope (AC-001, AC-002 worded as in the case), and the technical design (csv.writer default excel dialect, columns, ISO created_at; no mention of the LLM client), with STATE at DEVELOPING (FORWARD from ARCHITECTING). 60-export commits app/exports/csv_export.py (imports only csv), the COMPLETE development plan (DEV-001 DONE, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, self-check commands recorded), and STATE at TESTING with FORWARD from DEVELOPING, FULL_DELIVERABLE, recovery inactive, BlockedOn NONE. No verification report exists. Registries and api.openai.com are blocked.
